description_en: Retrieves the list of O&M applications that require approval
description_zh: 获取需要审批的运维申请列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-tickets --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationTickets

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.  
The maximum value of PageSize is 1000. The default number of entries per page is 20. If PageSize is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为1000。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The exact address of the asset pending approval for O&M
parameters.help_zh: 精确搜索待审批的运维资产地址
parameters.name: asset_address

OperationTickets.description_en: The list of O&M applications pending approval
OperationTickets.description_zh: 待审批的运维申请列表

ApplyUserId.description_en: The ID of the O&M applicant

ApplyUsername.description_en: The username of the O&M applicant

ApproveComment.description_en: The remarks provided by the O&M engineer when submitting the O&M application
ApproveComment.description_zh: 运维人员申请运维时填写的备注

AssetAccountId.description_en: The ID of the asset account for which O&M is requested

AssetAccountName.description_en: The logon name of the asset account for which O&M is requested
AssetAccountName.description_zh: 申请运维的资产账户登录名

AssetAddress.description_en: The address of the asset for which O&M is requested

AssetId.description_en: The ID of the asset for which O&M is requested

AssetName.description_en: The name of the asset for which O&M is requested

AssetNetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the requested asset belongs
AssetNetworkDomainId.description_zh: 申请运维的资产所属的网络域ID

AssetOs.description_en: The operating system type of the asset for which O&M is requested
AssetOs.description_zh: 申请运维的资产操作系统类型

AssetSource.description_en:
The name of the asset source to which the requested asset belongs. Valid values:
Local: local host
Ecs: ECS instance
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance
Name of a third-party asset source
AssetSource.description_zh:
申请运维的资产所属资产源的名称。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS实例
第三方资产源名称

AssetSourceInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the asset source to which the requested asset belongs
AssetSourceInstanceId.description_zh: 申请运维的资产所属资产源的ID

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the application was submitted, in seconds (UNIX timestamp format)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 提交申请的时间（秒，时间戳格式）

EffectCount.description_en:
The logon count limit requested by the O&M engineer. Valid values:

0: no limit on the number of logons. The O&M engineer can log on an unlimited number of times within the validity period.
1: the O&M engineer can log on only once within the validity period
EffectCount.description_zh:
运维人员申请的登录的次数限制。取值：

0：不限制登录次数，运维员在有效期内可以无限次数登录。
1：运维员在有效期内只允许登录一次

EffectEndTime.description_en:
The end time of the O&M period specified by the O&M engineer, in seconds (UNIX timestamp format).
A value of 0 indicates that the O&M engineer did not specify a time when submitting the application
EffectEndTime.description_zh:
运维人员填写的申请可以运维的结束时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
返回为0时表示运维人员在申请时未填写时间

EffectStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the O&M period specified by the O&M engineer, in seconds (UNIX timestamp format).
A value of 0 indicates that the O&M engineer did not specify a time when submitting the application
EffectStartTime.description_zh:
运维人员填写的申请可以运维的开始时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
返回为0时表示运维人员在申请时未填写时间

OperationTicketId.description_en: The ID of the O&M application that requires approval
OperationTicketId.description_zh: 需要审批的运维申请单的ID

ProtocolName.description_en: The protocol name for the requested O&M

State.description_en:
The approval status. Valid values:

Normal: pending approval
State.description_zh:
审批状态。取值：

Normal：待审批

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of O&M applications pending approval
TotalCount.description_zh: 待审批的运维申请单总数
